company_name: The Hong Kong and China Gas Company Limited (Towngas)

inputs.share_count_basis: 18,659,870,098 shares in issue at 30 June 2026 (H1 FY2026 interim note 14); the Company has no dilutive potential ordinary shares (note 9 -- dilution in reported diluted EPS arises only from subsidiary options/convertibles and reduces attributable profit, not the parent count). Held FLAT: no buybacks, and the pre-2022 annual 1-for-10 bonus issues have not recurred since FY2021.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report cash-flow reconciliation (note 40a, 'Share-based payment' HK$63.9m, line 10411); share-based payments are subsidiary (Towngas Smart Energy / EcoCeres-level) option grants only; no equity-award tax withholding.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-09T08:08:05Z regular close (Friday HKEX close; Yahoo chart API)
inputs.wacc_rationale: HKD-built (flows are HKD-reported; mainland earnings are RMB translated to HKD). Risk-free ~4.0% (HKD pegged to USD; 10y HKGB/UST blend), ERP 5.5%, beta ~0.75 for a regulated HK gas monopoly plus mainland city-gas -> cost of equity ~8.1%. Pre-tax cost of debt ~3.3% (FY2025 interest expense 1,971.9 / ~HK$60bn average borrowings), ~2.6% after tax. Market weights E 133bn / net debt 54bn (~71/29) give ~6.5%; rounded UP to 7.0% because roughly half of operating profit is mainland China city-gas. Same WACC in all scenarios -- risk is charged in the scenario flows, not stacked in the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), leases as debt: IFRS-16 lease liabilities (~HK$471.8m at FY2025: 100.3 current + 371.5 non-current, notes 9795/10109) are added to total_debt; lease cash (principal 122.2 + interest 20.3 = 142.5 in FY2025) is NOT deducted from the flows. Immaterial either way (~0.26% of revenue). total_debt = H1 FY2026 borrowings 16,669.8 + 45,856.5 = 62,526.3 + leases 471.8 (FY2025 figure carried; the interim does not restate the total).
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI charged ONCE, in the bridge: flows are 100% consolidated (EBITDA 11,935.0 = operating profit 8,132.1 + D&A 3,802.9), and the NCI stake is deducted at 10x the FY2025 NCI share of profit (1,026.7 -> 10,267), ~0.82x the H1 FY2026 NCI book of 12,542.3. 9,443 of the FY2025 NCI book is the ~1/3 outside holding in listed Towngas Smart Energy (1083.HK), which trades well below book; 10x sits between that market value and book. Calibration: modelled FY2025 EBIT 8,068 x (1-26%) - after-tax interest ~1,538 + other gains ~334 + associates/JVs 2,028 = ~6,794 vs reported profit incl. NCI 6,714.9; less NCI 1,026.7 = ~5,767 vs attributable 5,688.2 (1.4% tie).
inputs.associates_treatment: Share of results of associates (1,459.0) and JVs (569.0), and the HK$1.69bn of dividends they paid in FY2025 (investing activities), are EXCLUDED from the flows: EBITDA is operating profit before associates. Their source asset is in the equity bridge instead (matching-asset rule). Book value 52,108.4 at 30 June 2026 (associates 41,386.5 + JVs 10,721.9) is valued at 30,000 (~0.58x book): the 15.79% IFC (CWPI) stake (book 15,235; FY2025 dividend 410.5) at ~0.6x NAV like HK landlords, ~9,000; the mainland gas/midstream/water associates and JVs plus 42.3% EcoCeres at ~12x their FY2025 share of results (~1,692 ex-IFC), ~20,300; plus ~700 for EcoCeres's step-up (H1 FY2026 associates 1,404.4 vs 534.8). A completed EcoCeres IPO above that mark is upside not in the base.
inputs.interest_treatment: Towngas classifies interest paid (1,954.8 FY2025) in FINANCING, so OCF and the stored FreeCashFlow are pre-interest. That is the right basis for this unlevered build: flows are discounted at WACC and the full net debt is deducted once in the bridge. Adding interest back or subtracting it again would double-count. interest_income = 0 (net debt, not net cash); the 91.4 interest received and 123.0 dividends from securities are excluded from EBITDA and their source assets (investment securities, cash) are in the bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route, with the non-US adaptations (dcf-methods routing row 'operating company, non-US'): Towngas is an operating utility (HK piped-gas franchise + mainland city-gas + water/renewables), not a bank/REIT/LIC/holdco, so FCF is meaningful. It straddles 'operating company' and 'holdco' only through its large equity-accounted portfolio, which is handled as a sum-of-parts in the equity bridge (associates/JVs and investment securities at value, NCI deducted) rather than by switching models. First valuation of this ticker (no memory entry, no prior DCF). SBC-zero-ish market: SBC kept explicit at 0.12% of revenue; the house/street band is ~1-2% wide, effectively collapsed. Buyback_cash = 0: Towngas does not repurchase; the flat count is a modelling convention that holds only because bonus issues stopped after FY2021 (shares 13,988m FY2017 -> 18,660m FY2021). Capex: group PPE capex fell 8,359.7 (FY2023) -> 6,435.5 -> 5,096.3 (FY2025) -> 1,957.0 in H1 FY2026 as mainland new-connection build slows and growth projects shift to asset-light/quasi-REIT funding; base path 8.5% of revenue fading to 7.5% (D&A 7.0%), i.e. maintenance plus modest growth. HK$13.1bn HK-utility capex over 2026-2031 (~HK$2.2bn/yr) sits inside that. Cash tax 26% of unlevered EBIT: FY2025 cash tax 1,788.8 plus the ~22% interest shield on 1,971.9 of interest over EBIT+other gains ~8,486. Working capital capture 0: payables and customer deposits/deferred connection fees (9,226) exceed receivables+inventory, but connection prepayments are shrinking, so neither sign is reliable.

equity_bridge.item: Associates and joint ventures at value (~0.58x 30-Jun-2026 book of 52,108.4)
equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet lines 1617-1618; IFC/CWPI 15.79% (FY2025 AR note 21, book 15,235.4) at ~0.6x NAV; remainder at ~12x FY2025 share of results; income excluded from flows

equity_bridge.item: Net loans to associates and JVs
equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026: receivables from associates 1,016.6 + JVs 1,708.1 - payables to associates 79.1 - JVs 131.5 - loan from a JV 355.7
H1 FY2026: FVOCI 1,519.1 + FVTPL non-current 1,719.7 + current 1,444.2; their dividend income (205.5 in H1 FY2026) is excluded from EBITDA
FY2025 NCI share of profit 1,026.7; H1 FY2026 NCI book 12,542.3 (9,443 of FY2025 book is Towngas Smart Energy 1083.HK minority)

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (-2.3% 5yr, -1.0% 3yr) diverges >30% from revenue (+5.8% 5yr) and EPS. Equity is depressed by RMB translation losses (FY2022 -6.2bn equity on FX) and by paying out ~115% of attributable profit as dividends (6,531 vs 5,688 in FY2025), so it is not a usable growth proxy; EPS 3yr CAGR selected. Revenue swings are gas-price pass-through (FY2022 peak 60.95bn on fuel cost adjustment), not volume.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are on the owner-FCF series (reported FCF less SBC; interest_income not deducted as the company is net-debt) and are flattered by a falling capex base (FY2022 7,724.7 -> FY2025 5,096.3) and a FY2025 working-capital release (receivables -1.6bn); FY2022 owner FCF 1,933.5 was a trough. Owner FCF here is PRE-interest (interest paid sits in financing) -- after ~1.95bn of interest and before 1.69bn of associate/JV dividends, the equity-level cash flow is ~5.1bn against 6.53bn of shareholder dividends plus 0.65bn to NCI, a gap funded by borrowings (37.9bn FY2019 -> 62.5bn H1 FY2026). SBC CAGR is not meaningful (tiny, lumpy subsidiary grants).

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 +4%: H1 revenue +7.3% on gas-price pass-through and Gas+ services, H2 softer (mainland apparent consumption -2.4% H1, warm winter) but HK tariff +4.4% from 1-Aug-2026. Then ~3% (HK volumes ~flat + tariff, mainland volumes +2-3%, connection income declining) fading to 2%.
base.margin_rationale: FY2025 EBITDA margin 22.0%; H1 FY2026 operating margin fell to 15.0% from 16.9% (renewables -53% at TSE, pass-through lag), so FY2026 dips to 21.5% before HK tariff and the RMB0.54-0.55/m3 mainland dollar margin restore ~22%.

scenario_narratives.base: Towngas stays what it has been since 2022: a ~flat-volume HK gas monopoly earning its tariff (+4.4% Aug-2026, then a two-year freeze) beside a mainland city-gas platform whose new-connection income keeps shrinking with the property market while the RMB0.54-0.55/m3 dollar margin holds as residential cost pass-through approaches completion. Gas+ services, water trusteeship and Towngas Lifestyle replace connection income but do not accelerate growth; renewables recover from midday-valley pricing to modest profitability. Group capex settles near maintenance plus ~0.5pp of revenue. Revenue compounds ~3% fading to 2%, EBITDA margin ~22%. Associates (IFC, mainland gas JVs, EcoCeres) are carried in the bridge at ~0.58x book.
scenario_narratives.bull: Mainland reform works in Towngas's favour: pass-through completes (residential 100%), Gas+ and integrated energy services lift the dollar margin toward RMB0.58/m3, distributed PV reaches the 3.8 GW target with power-market reform easing valley pricing, and Northern Metropolis adds a multi-year HK connection pipeline. Revenue 4-5% early, EBITDA margin to 23.5%, terminal growth 2.5%. (EcoCeres's IPO at a premium valuation would add on top through the bridge, which is held at the base mark.)
scenario_narratives.bear: The mainland property slump persists and city-gas volumes stagnate on warm winters and industrial weakness; connection income falls away faster, renewables stay squeezed by midday-valley pricing, and the post-2028 HK tariff reset is politically capped while opex and the HK$13.1bn HK capex programme rise. Revenue grows ~1.5%, EBITDA margin erodes to 20.5% and capex stays ~8.3-9% as the sprawl of growth ventures (SAF, green methanol, hydrogen, data centres) keeps absorbing capital. Leverage stays near 43% gearing with dividends funded partly by debt.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 20% (up from 15%): mainland property and electricity-market reform are live headwinds and the dividend is partly debt-funded, but the HK franchise is a defensive floor with no refinancing stress (A1/A- ratings). Base 55%: an established utility with a narrow outcome band. Bull 25% (down from 35%): it needs pass-through completion, renewables recovery and Gas+ traction to land together.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide to within ~2% (SBC 0.12% of revenue, subsidiary option grants only): the band collapses and band_position is null rather than a degenerate ratio.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Unlevered owner-FCF DCF of the consolidated operations at an HKD 7% WACC, plus a sum-of-parts bridge for the HK$52bn equity-accounted portfolio and HK$4.7bn of securities, less the NCI stake and HK$54.5bn of net debt. The market prices Towngas as a ~4.9% dividend yield bond proxy; the DCF asks whether the cash the operations generate supports that, and the answer is shaped by the fact that the dividend (6.53bn) has exceeded equity-level free cash flow for years, with the gap borrowed.
key_risks_to_valuation: Associates/JVs bridge (30bn, ~0.58x book) is a judgment mark worth ~HK$1.6/share; at book it would add ~HK$1.2/share
WACC: at 6% (yield-investor cost of capital for HK utilities) the value rises materially; the 18x terminal cap binds at 7%/2%
EcoCeres IPO valuation (42.3% stake) could crystallise value above the bridge mark
RMB/HKD translation: roughly half of operating profit is RMB-denominated
Capex normalisation: the base assumes group capex stays near FY2025-H1 FY2026 levels rather than reverting to the 12-15% of revenue spent in FY2021-2023
